parts.label: (a)
parts.question_text: State what is meant by the centre of gravity of an object.
parts.question_text_latex: State what is meant by the centre of gravity of an object.

parts.label: (b)
parts.question_text:
A uniform beam AB is attached by a frictionless hinge to a vertical wall at end A. The beam is
held so that it is horizontal by a metal wire CD, as shown in Fig. 3.1.
The beam is of length 0.96 m and weight 23 N. A block of weight W rests on the beam at a
distance of 0.20 m from end B. The wire is attached to the beam at point D which is a distance
of 0.40 m from end B. The wire exerts a force on the beam of 45 N at an angle of 37° to the
horizontal. The beam is in equilibrium.
parts.question_text_latex:
A uniform beam AB is attached by a frictionless hinge to a vertical wall at end A. The beam is
held so that it is horizontal by a metal wire CD, as shown in Fig. 3.1.
The beam is of length 0.96 m and weight 23 N. A block of weight W rests on the beam at a
distance of 0.20 m from end B. The wire is attached to the beam at point D which is a distance
of 0.40 m from end B. The wire exerts a force on the beam of 45 N at an angle of 37° to the
horizontal. The beam is in equilibrium.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.question_text:
Calculate the vertical component of the force exerted by the wire on the beam.
vertical component of the force = N
parts.question_text_latex:
Calculate the vertical component of the force exerted by the wire on the beam.
vertical component of the force = N

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.question_text:
By taking moments about A, calculate the weight W of the block.
W = N
parts.question_text_latex:
By taking moments about A, calculate the weight W of the block.
$W = N $

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.question_text:
The hinge exerts a force on the beam at end A.
Calculate the horizontal component of this force.
horizontal component of force = N
parts.question_text_latex:
The hinge exerts a force on the beam at end A.
Calculate the horizontal component of this force.
horizontal component of force = N

parts.label: (b)(iv)
parts.question_text:
The block is now placed closer to point D on the beam.
State whether this change will increase, decrease or have no effect on the tension in the
wire.
parts.question_text_latex:
The block is now placed closer to point D on the beam.
State whether this change will increase, decrease or have no effect on the tension in the
wire.

parts.label: (b)(v)
parts.question_text:
The stress in the wire is 5.3 × 10^{7} Pa. The wire is now replaced by a second wire that has
a radius which is three times greater than that of the original wire. The tension in the wire
is unchanged.
Calculate the stress in the second wire.
stress = Pa
